title: Finite adaptive conditional-kernel TV telescope
source_anchor: Chen–Chewi–Lu–Zhang, arXiv:2609.38710v1, Section 6.1, Lemma 6.3 (TV error bound)
target_statement: On a fixed finite dummy-filled history space of length T_max, telescope ideal and implemented adaptive conditional probability kernels one slot at a time. If delta_t is the expected total-variation distance of the t-th kernels under the ideal capped history, then the implemented capped output differs from the ideal capped output by at most sum_t delta_t. A separate ideal capped-versus-uncapped comparison adds epsilon_cap exactly once.
